name: RWIS Warning Manager v7
description: Groups the model's warnings by type and classifies them with the RWIS tables. 1 Review: one 3D view per warning type, coloured by severity, with elements that would be deleted in MAGENTA (no changes). 2 Solve the type in the active WRN view. 3 Step through each type. 4 Solve ALL. Before any 3D element (wall, floor, family...) is deleted it is highlighted magenta, selected and zoomed to, with the kept element in green, and you choose Delete / Keep / Delete all. Room-boundary fixes that cannot move or break a room (redundant separation lines, tiny off-axis separation lines) are applied without asking. Every run updates Desktop\RWIS Reports\<model>_RWIS_Warnings_Report.xlsx: all warnings sorted by criticality with status, what AICon changed, risk and fixes; rows where AICon deleted an element are RED with the deleted IDs. One Ctrl+Z undoes a run.

inputs.name: action
inputs.label: What to do
options: 1. Review - 3D view per warning type (no changes)
2. Solve the warning type in the active WRN 3D view
3. Solve - step through each warning type (confirm each)
4. Solve ALL warnings at once (hurry mode)

inputs.name: unpinToFix
inputs.label: Unpin to fix (pinned elements: unpin -> fix -> re-pin)

inputs.name: contains
inputs.label: Only warnings containing (text, class ID or T-code - optional)
